A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CLAMP research work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices are readable and support reliable matching, including the additional material and checklist in v2.

before.justification: V1 reports original CLAMP classification results, training-dynamics and representation analyses, Brain-Score evaluations, and hyperparameter ablations.

after.justification: V2 retains original empirical analyses, revises classification results, and adds VOC object-detection results and a batch-size ablation.

M1.justification: The encoder, projection head, normalization, manifold construction and packing-loss optimization remain unchanged. Equation 1 replaces the radius denominator b with m, matching the procedure already specified in v1 Algorithm 1 and Appendix J; this resolves an inconsistency rather than introducing a different algorithm.

E1.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendix H add object detection using VOC2007+2012 training data and the VOC2007 test set. This substantially extends evaluation to object localization and detection beyond the retained classification, geometric and neural-recording tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding ImageNet, CIFAR-10 and Brain-Score comparisons. The new VOC evaluation reuses SimCLR, Barlow Twins, BYOL, MoCo v2 and MMCR. Added momentum-encoder descriptions for MMCR accompany the same cited scores and clarify its configuration.

E3.justification: Appendix D changes the reported radius scale from 7.0 to 8.5, ImageNet-100/1K batch sizes from 800/1024 to 512, and the ImageNet-1K learning-rate coefficient from 0.9 to 1.1. Appendix G revises the learning-rate sweep. V2 also adds full-dataset eight-view evaluations, Faster R-CNN detection evaluated with mAP/AP50/AP75, and a full-ImageNet batch-size sweep.

E4.justification: Appendix L.3 adds a focused batch-size sensitivity analysis: batches of 256, 512 and 1024 yield accuracies of 69.02, 69.43 and 69.11. The existing radius-scale and augmentation-count ablations, training-dynamics analyses and representation visualizations are retained.

E5.justification: V1 reports uncertainty values without identifying their convention or classification run count. V2 checklist item 7 specifies two-sigma errors from three independent experiments with different seeds and attributes Brain-Score errors to the library. This newly documents uncertainty estimation; it does not establish an increase in runs.

E6.justification: Table 1 replaces four-view ImageNet-100/1K accuracies of 83.96/69.16 with 85.12/69.50 and semi-supervised 1%/10% results of 46.7/64.6 with 47.38/65.10. These accompany revised training settings, so they are not controlled same-setting gains. V2 adds eight-view results, VOC detection results of 55.7 mAP, 82.3 AP50 and 62.4 AP75, and batch-size results. CIFAR-10 and Brain-Score values remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix C corrects runtime bounds by replacing min(m,b) with max(m,b). V2 also corrects Equation 1's radius denominator and revises the radius-volume exponent to a reciprocal. The existing volume derivation remains, but Appendix K.2 introduces an erroneous equality between V and an expression previously established only as its upper bound.

C1.justification: The abstract and introductory contributions retain the same central claims: physics-inspired manifold packing, competitive classification including ImageNet-100 state-of-the-art performance, interpretable training dynamics, and cortical representational alignment. The additional experiments do not redefine these core contributions.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 newly clarifies that short-range embedding interactions still produce weight updates affecting all embeddings. Section 8 explicitly cautions that Brain-Score agreement does not establish identical cortical computations or dynamics. Section 4.3 adds an interpretation of detection results as evidence of transfer to spatially structured tasks.

D1.justification: V2 adds a code-repository address in Section 3.2, clarifies MMCR's momentum-encoder configuration, and documents detection implementation details, including a base learning rate of 0.07. Conversely, it removes the ablation-specific learning rate, weight decay and zero-momentum settings given in v1 Appendix K.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations and brief discussion of hard-negative contrastive learning, collapse-proof non-contrastive learning, and Hebbian/predictive plasticity, corresponding to references 26, 28 and 52. The established positioning relative to particle physics, Alignment-Uniformity and MMCR remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: The main section sequence and most prose remain intact. V2 makes localized terminology and language edits, shortens the training-dynamics explanation, and adds detection and batch-size subsections plus a NeurIPS checklist. This is a limited expansion rather than an extensive narrative rewrite.

P2.justification: V2 adds detection Table 2 and batch-size Table 9, expands Table 1 with an eight-view row and a longer caption, and updates Brain-Score table labels and highlighting. Existing figures retain the same graphical content, with some resizing and relocation; appendix tables and captions are renumbered or clarified.

improvement.justification: The VOC transfer test and batch-size analysis strengthen empirical support, while newly explained uncertainty, code-access information and corrected formulas improve transparency. These provide a limited net gain over an already established method and evaluation. The benefit is tempered by removal of ablation optimizer details and the erroneous equality introduced in Appendix K.2; higher classification scores also accompany changed settings and do not independently establish improved quality.
